#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s RELEASE_DIRECTORY\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

release=$1
case $release in
    /*) candidate=$release ;;
    *)  candidate=$base/$release ;;
esac

if [ ! -d "$candidate" ]; then
    printf 'publish: release directory does not exist: %s\n' "$release" >&2
    exit 66
fi
if [ ! -f "$candidate/MANIFEST" ]; then
    printf 'publish: refusing release without MANIFEST: %s\n' "$release" >&2
    exit 65
fi

tmpdir=$(mktemp -d "$base/.publish.XXXXXX")
cleanup()
{
    rm -f -- "$tmpdir/current"
    rmdir -- "$tmpdir" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

ln -s -- "$release" "$tmpdir/current"
mv -Tf -- "$tmpdir/current" "$base/current"
rmdir -- "$tmpdir"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
ANTRIEB_PUBLISH_EOF
sh -n "$new"
install -m 0755 -o root -g root "$new" "$base/bin/.publish.new"
chcon --reference="$base/bin/publish" "$base/bin/.publish.new"
mv -f -- "$base/bin/.publish.new" "$base/bin/publish"
sh -n "$base/bin/publish"
printf '%s\n' 'installed publisher:'
sed -n '1,240p' "$base/bin/publish"
stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U:%G context=%C' "$base/bin/publish"
rm -f -- "$new"

set -eu

cleanup()
{

: > "$work/run"
reader()
{
    id=$1
    count=0
    missing=0
    bad=0
    while [ -e "$work/run" ]; do
        if ! readlink "$base/current" >/dev/null 2>&1; then

                bad=$((bad + 1))

        fi
        count=$((count + 1))

    printf 'reader=%s snapshots=%s missing=%s incomplete_or_mixed=%s\n' "$id" "$count" "$missing" "$bad" > "$work/result.$id"
}

reader 2 & p2=$!
reader 3 & p3=$!
reader 4 & p4=$!
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 300 ]; do
    "$publisher" releases/two

set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/atomic-release-publication
publisher=$base/bin/publish
old_boot=d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6
new_boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
[ "$new_boot" != "$old_boot" ]
printf 'old_boot_id=%s new_boot_id=%s changed=yes\n' "$old_boot" "$new_boot"
printf 'os=%s kernel=%s system_state=%s sshd=%s\n' "$(. /etc/os-release && printf '%s' "$PRETTY_NAME")" "$(uname -r)" "$(systemctl is-system-running)" "$(systemctl is-active sshd)"
sh -n "$publisher"
printf 'publisher_sha256='; sha256sum "$publisher" | awk '{print $1}'
stat -c 'publisher_mode=%a publisher_owner=%U:%G publisher_context=%C' "$publisher"
printf 'recovered_current=%s resolved=%s\n' "$(readlink "$base/current")" "$(readlink -f "$base/current")"
test -f "$base/current/MANIFEST"
cmp -s "$base/current/MANIFEST" "$base/releases/one/MANIFEST"
cmp -s "$base/current/index.txt" "$base/releases/one/index.txt"
printf '%s\n' 'recovered_current_complete=yes'
"$publisher" releases/two
cmp -s "$base/current/MANIFEST" "$base/releases/two/MANIFEST"
cmp -s "$base/current/index.txt" "$base/releases/two/index.txt"
printf 'post_restart_publish=%s complete=yes\n' "$(readlink "$base/current")"
before=$(readlink "$base/current")
set +e
reject_output=$("$publisher" releases/incomplete 2>&1)
reject_rc=$?
set -e
after=$(readlink "$base/current")
[ "$reject_rc" -eq 65 ]
[ "$before" = "$after" ]
printf 'post_restart_rejection_rc=%s retained=%s message=%s\n' "$reject_rc" "$after" "$reject_output"
"$publisher" releases/one
cmp -s "$base/current/MANIFEST" "$base/releases/one/MANIFEST"
cmp -s "$base/current/index.txt" "$base/releases/one/index.txt"
printf 'post_restart_rollback=%s complete=yes\n' "$(readlink "$base/current")"
for release in one two incomplete; do test -d "$base/releases/$release"; done
printf '%s\n' 'staged_releases=one,two,incomplete all_present=yes'
leftovers=$(find "$base" -maxdepth 1 -name '.publish.*' -print)
[ -z "$leftovers" ]
if systemctl list-units --all --no-legend | grep -q [REDACTED]; then exit 1; fi
printf '%s\n' 'publisher_temp_leftovers=none transient_reboot_units=none'
